entries.name: MyTripPlanner
entries.summary: Self-hosted road-trip itinerary planner with day-by-day timeline, map routes, budgets and multi-trip management.

leaf_matches.reason: MyTripPlanner README describes trips as persistent containers with places, transport, stays and notes arranged into day-by-day itineraries and map routes, which matches the trip/items/arrangement core.

license_review.rationale: The GitHub license API snapshot contains the full AGPL v3 text with a project-specific copyright header. The API reports NOASSERTION because of that header, but the decoded 32 KB text is the complete GNU AGPL version 3 with standard terms and conditions markers.

entries.name: TravelyOS
entries.summary: Tour-operator back office for supplier and inventory management: supplier/DMC directory with contracts and rates, contracted allotments tied to live bookings, and purchase-order and vendor-payable reconciliation.

leaf_matches.reason: The official back-office page describes a system of record for hotels, DMCs and transport vendors with contracted rates, validity periods and allotments, tied to live trips and to purchase orders and vendor payables, matching the supplier base plus trade terms plus resale/operation binding.

entries.name: CampLife
entries.summary: Campground and RV park management platform covering online reservations, site guarantee, mobile check-in, point of sale, recurring billing and cash- or accrual-basis accounting from booking to check-out.

leaf_matches.reason: CampLife's official page presents operator-side campground management with reservations, site guarantee, mobile check-in, point of sale, recurring billing and accounting from online booking to check-out, covering the site-reservation, front-desk stay and settlement workflow at a basic product level.

entries.name: luca
entries.summary: Hotel digital concierge platform: guests use email, WhatsApp and an AI concierge, routine questions are answered automatically, complex requests become staff tasks, and the service is tied to PMS and digital check-in.

leaf_matches.reason: The official hotel page describes digital guest intake over email/WhatsApp, an AI concierge, PMS-integrated check-in, and complex guest requests turned into staff tasks, matching guest/stay anchoring, digital intake, tracked requests and property-side fulfillment.

entries.name: Mangobeds
entries.summary: Hostel management platform built around bed-level dorm and private-room inventory, with fast check-in/check-out, group bookings, OTA sync, booking engine and invoicing.

leaf_matches.reason: Mangobeds' official hostel page describes bed-level dorm and private-room inventory, fast check-in/check-out, group bookings, OTA availability sync, a booking engine and invoicing, covering the bed-stock, staff stay lifecycle and per-stay financial record at a basic product level.
